column1: # USEFULNESS THRESHOLDS for the puzzle15 stress theorem (tasks.md D3) — the committed claims Puzzle15Check
# holds every certificate to.  A threshold is a claim about the WIDTH of a predicted interval,
# `(hi + 1) / (lo + 1)`, per declaration, backend and component: `finite` claims only that the bound is finite,
# a number claims the width is at most that.  Soundness (the counted run inside the interval) is gated
# separately and unconditionally; failing a threshold is SOUND-BUT-NOT-USEFUL, not unsound.
# declarations:  value:1        the frontier declared BY VALUE as the single initial board
#                value:level2   the frontier declared BY VALUE as the boards two moves from the initial one
#                symbolic:1     the frontier declared as ONE path of length 16 (nothing about its items)
#                symbolic:4     the frontier declared as at most FOUR paths of length 16
